purpose: attribute a held-playing section-copy terminal to worker publication and recovery on a generated reference workload
build: cargo test --release, allocation-probe enabled; optimized headless test binary, not an exact full local-CI or release-qualified app

fixture.description: 16 tracks, 512 clips, 16 sections, 44100 Hz; temporary copied project and recovery journal
fixture.note: project includes generated absolute paths, so its hash depends on the fixture directory

command: HEX_SECTION_BENCH_PROJECT=/tmp/hex-7660-section-fixture/project.hex HEX_SECTION_BENCH_REPS=7 HEX_SECTION_BENCH_RECOVERY=1 HEX_SECTION_BENCH_DUPLICATE_ONLY=1 cargo test --release --locked -p hex-desktop --features allocation-probe --bin hex-desktop -- native_audio::tests::section_benchmark::section_edit_benchmark --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1
method: one warm-up then seven copies and undos at early cursor while playing; headless callback rendered in 64-frame blocks and polled at approximately 1 ms; report median and maximum in milliseconds
interpretation: Recovery accounts for most of this synthetic workload's worker time. Callback time is first observation of matching output, revision and source context, not a physical-device timing. This fixture and sample do not establish the cause of the historical 1.768-second user-project delay or prove an improvement. No user project, native interaction or listening was tested.
